air_quality_note: Haze season underway; open-burning ban in force (Chiang Mai 2026 ban: 1 Jan-31 May). PM2.5 often above Thai 24h standard (37.5 ug/m3). Cold-air inversions trap smoke in the valley.

lanna_month.note: Approximate: lunar months drift against Gregorian months each year; Lanna count = Central Thai lunar month + 2. Month 1 is called เดือนเกี๋ยง (kiang), not เดือนอ้าย.

what_locals_talk_about: Cool mornings (often ~15C, colder in the hills) - locals remark it is cold (หนาว, nao) and wear jackets; peak tourist/flower season; smoke starting to be mentioned.
source_note: Climate normals 1991-2020 for TMD station Chiang Mai (WMO 48327), as tabulated on Wikipedia citing WMO; seasons per https://www.thailand.go.th/issue-focus-detail/009_142; Lanna month mapping per https://anowl.co/anowlrod/sa-bpa/lao-reuang_winner_ep12/

season: cool -> hot (TMD: hot season from mid-Feb)
air_quality_note: Haze worsening; agricultural and forest burning. Chiang Mai 2021 monthly mean PM2.5 47.7 ug/m3 (IQAir).

lanna_month.note: Approximate: lunar months drift against Gregorian months each year; Lanna count = Central Thai lunar month + 2. Month 1 is called เดือนเกี๋ยง (kiang), not เดือนอ้าย.

what_locals_talk_about: Days warming fast, dry; talk turns to ฝุ่น (fun, dust/PM2.5) and masks, checking AQI apps; burning ban.
source_note: Climate normals 1991-2020 for TMD station Chiang Mai (WMO 48327), as tabulated on Wikipedia citing WMO; seasons per https://www.thailand.go.th/issue-focus-detail/009_142; Lanna month mapping per https://anowl.co/anowlrod/sa-bpa/lao-reuang_winner_ep12/

air_quality_note: Usually the WORST month for smoke. Chiang Mai 2021 monthly mean PM2.5 83.3 ug/m3 (IQAir); late March 2026 hit purple alert level. Visibility of Doi Suthep often lost.

lanna_month.note: Approximate: lunar months drift against Gregorian months each year; Lanna count = Central Thai lunar month + 2. Month 1 is called เดือนเกี๋ยง (kiang), not เดือนอ้าย.

what_locals_talk_about: Hottest-and-smokiest stretch: ฝุ่นควัน (fun khwan, dust-smoke) and ไฟป่า (fai pa, forest fires) dominate small talk; masks, air purifiers, people leaving town; 'ฮ้อน' (hon, Kham Mueang for hot).
source_note: Climate normals 1991-2020 for TMD station Chiang Mai (WMO 48327), as tabulated on Wikipedia citing WMO; seasons per https://www.thailand.go.th/issue-focus-detail/009_142; Lanna month mapping per https://anowl.co/anowlrod/sa-bpa/lao-reuang_winner_ep12/

air_quality_note: Smoke typically persists into April until pre-monsoon storms clear the air; varies by year.

lanna_month.note: Approximate: lunar months drift against Gregorian months each year; Lanna count = Central Thai lunar month + 2. Month 1 is called เดือนเกี๋ยง (kiang), not เดือนอ้าย.

what_locals_talk_about: Peak heat (avg high ~37C). 'ฮ้อนใบ้ฮ้อนง่าว' (hon bai hon ngao, 'extremely hot' in Kham Mueang). Pi Mai Mueang / Songkran water festival 13-15 April falls in Lanna month 7 (เดือนเจ็ด) = Lanna New Year; water-throwing offers relief from heat.
source_note: Climate normals 1991-2020 for TMD station Chiang Mai (WMO 48327), as tabulated on Wikipedia citing WMO; seasons per https://www.thailand.go.th/issue-focus-detail/009_142; Lanna month mapping per https://anowl.co/anowlrod/sa-bpa/lao-reuang_winner_ep12/

season: hot -> rainy (TMD: rainy season from mid-May)
air_quality_note: Air usually improves as rains begin; burning-control period can still be in force (to 31 May in 2026).

lanna_month.note: Approximate: lunar months drift against Gregorian months each year; Lanna count = Central Thai lunar month + 2. Month 1 is called เดือนเกี๋ยง (kiang), not เดือนอ้าย.

what_locals_talk_about: First storms; relief from heat and smoke. Hed thop / hed phao (เห็ดถอบ / เห็ดเผาะ, earthstar mushrooms) appear at markets and roadsides after alternating rain and heat, sold by the litre at high prices early in season. Inthakhin city-pillar festival (late May-early June).
source_note: Climate normals 1991-2020 for TMD station Chiang Mai (WMO 48327), as tabulated on Wikipedia citing WMO; seasons per https://www.thailand.go.th/issue-focus-detail/009_142; Lanna month mapping per https://anowl.co/anowlrod/sa-bpa/lao-reuang_winner_ep12/

air_quality_note: Generally clean air (rain washes out particulates).

lanna_month.note: Approximate: lunar months drift against Gregorian months each year; Lanna count = Central Thai lunar month + 2. Month 1 is called เดือนเกี๋ยง (kiang), not เดือนอ้าย.

what_locals_talk_about: Rainy season settling in; rice planting in valleys; afternoon/evening downpours; talk about getting caught in rain on motorbikes.
source_note: Climate normals 1991-2020 for TMD station Chiang Mai (WMO 48327), as tabulated on Wikipedia citing WMO; seasons per https://www.thailand.go.th/issue-focus-detail/009_142; Lanna month mapping per https://anowl.co/anowlrod/sa-bpa/lao-reuang_winner_ep12/

what_locals_talk_about: Rainy; Buddhist Lent (Khao Phansa) begins around the July full moon. Green season, fewer tourists.

what_locals_talk_about: Cool, dry and pleasant; Yi Peng (ยี่เป็ง) = full moon of Lanna month 2 (เดือนยี่), coinciding with Loi Krathong (full moon of Central Thai month 12). Lanterns, krathong; very busy.
